stories.title: Kendall Jenner faces backlash in India over Om beachwear
stories.summary: Kendall Jenner has faced criticism in India after wearing a cloth featuring the sacred Om symbol over her bikini during a yacht trip. Social media users argued the religious symbol should not be treated as a fashion accessory. The garment was featured in photos shared by Kylie Jenner.

stories.title: Kendall Jenner faces backlash in India over Om beachwear
stories.summary: Kendall Jenner has faced criticism from Indian social media users after wearing a cloth featuring the sacred Hindu symbol Om as a beach cover-up. The model's outfit sparked debate over the appropriateness of using religious symbols in fashion. The controversy began after photographs were shared on Instagram.

stories.title: Parryware marks decades in Indian homes
stories.summary: Parryware has remained a familiar name across generations of Indian homes since its founding in 1952. The brand introduced the industry's first coupled closet in 1985 and joined Spain's Roca Group in 2006. It continues to combine contemporary design with accessible premium experiences for the Indian market.

stories.title: President Murmu to grace 12th National Handloom Day celebrations on August 7 - DD News
Manipur Designer Robert Naorem Showcases State’s Rich Handloom Heritage at India to Spain Festival In Madrid - Northeast
West Bengal universities urged to drop colonial gowns
stories.summary: The West Bengal government has initiated steps to replace Western-style convocation gowns and mortarboard caps with traditional Indian attire. The Higher Education Department issued an advisory to universities on November 23, citing a need to promote indigenous culture and handloom fabrics over European-style academic robes.

stories.title: Sai Pallavi Meets Amit Shah With Ramayana Team In Pink Saree And Gold Jewellery - NDTV
Indian fashion labels explore traditional craftsmanship
stories.summary: Five Indian fashion labels are building design languages through textile and material experimentation. Founders Sharan Adka and Shreya Parasrampuria of Day and Age rework vintage kantha quilts and khadi into one-of-a-kind garments. The labels focus on the relationship between text, textile, and time.

stories.title: Provogue sponsors Roadies Rebirth season 21
stories.summary: Provogue has joined Roadies Rebirth Season 21 as an associate sponsor. The brand aims to build relationships with Gen Z and aspirational consumers by aligning with the reality show's format. Both brands claim a natural affinity with the youth of India and the celebration of individuality.

stories.title: Julianne Hough addresses season 35 fashion criticism
stories.summary: Dancing With the Stars cohost Julianne Hough is responding to criticism regarding her fashion choices during season 35. Hough stated she is in a leading lady era and dressing with more intention. She noted that in her late 30s she no longer tries to fit into what is hot.

stories.title: Julianne Hough stylist defends season 35 looks
stories.summary: Julianne Hough has been wearing polarizing high-fashion looks for the recently wrapped Season 35 of Dancing With the Stars. Stylist Brad Goreski defended the choices, noting that Hough is embracing the show's themes. The looks included a silver mirrorball dress previously worn by Mariah Carey.

stories.title: Veruschka, fashion icon considered one of the first supermodels, has died - KGW
Hunter Schafer adopts futuristic style for press tour
stories.summary: Hunter Schafer is wearing futuristic-themed outfits during her Blade Runner 2099 press tour. Stylist Dara has shared looks including a metallic McQueen cable-knit sweater and Prada sunglasses. The wardrobe aims to interpret the sci-fi aesthetic beyond the red carpet premiere.

stories.title: Jennifer Lopez wears white after Labor Day
stories.summary: Jennifer Lopez wore a semi-sheer white sweater for Thanksgiving, breaking the traditional fashion rule of wearing no white after Labor Day. The outfit was worn during her first holiday following her split from Ben Affleck. The singer paired the knit with a nude bra and blue jeans.

stories.title: Hailey Bieber wears sheer Gucci for Vogue France
stories.summary: Hailey Bieber wore a sheer Gucci lace embroidered dress for a portrait in Vogue France. The slip dress featured an underwired bustier bodice and a plunging neckline. The model discussed her brand Rhode and her career during an interview accompanying the fashion feature.

stories.title: Supermodel Veruschka dies at 87
stories.summary: Pioneering German supermodel Veruschka, known for her 1960s Vogue shoots and role in the film Blow-Up, has died in Berlin at age 87. Her passing was confirmed by the fashion label run by her sister. She is credited with helping pioneer the modern supermodel era.

stories.title: Simone Ashley wears archival Gucci
stories.summary: Simone Ashley wore an archival Gucci by Tom Ford cherry blossom micro minidress to a premiere in London. The dress, sourced from Epoque Couture, originated from the fashion house's Spring/Summer 2003 collection. The actress is making a strong case for archival fashion with her recent red carpet appearances.

stories.title: Celebrities dominate UK Christmas advertising
stories.summary: Celebrities are increasingly prominent in UK Christmas adverts, appearing in 56 percent of campaigns this year compared to 30 percent in 2024. Analysis by XR Extreme Reach suggests traditional festive food is disappearing from campaigns as brands prioritize celebrity-led fashion and lifestyle messaging.

stories.title: Gold and silver prices record gains
stories.summary: Gold and silver prices rose in the Indian bullion market following a period of sharp corrections. According to the India Bullion and Jewellers Association, 999-purity gold closed at ₹1,22,641 per 10 grams, while silver reached ₹1,47,347 per kilogram. The market is now waiting to see if the trend continues.

stories.title: Gold prices rebound in commodity market
stories.summary: Gold prices recovered in the Indian commodity market on November 26, 2026, with MCX gold trading at ₹1,22,610 per 10 grams. The gain of approximately 1.22 percent follows recent selling pressure. Uncertainty remains regarding whether the current recovery signals a stronger rebound or is merely a temporary fluctuation.

stories.title: Mumbai jeweller targeted in extortion plot
stories.summary: Mumbai police are investigating a shooting at PC Jain Jewellers in Mahim. The owner, Bharat Jain, reportedly received multiple death threats and demands for ₹10 crore last month. Jain initially dismissed the messages as spam. Two assailants fired three rounds at the store on Wednesday evening.

stories.title: Gold loan defaults rise as prices fall
stories.summary: A 31 percent drop in gold prices from the January peak has increased pressure on borrowers who pledged jewellery for loans. The share of gold loans overdue by 31 to 90 days rose to 1.3 percent in September. Borrowers are advised to verify valuations and seek written settlement agreements.

Gunmen fire at Mumbai jewellery shop
stories.summary: Two men on a motorcycle fired three rounds at P.C. Jain Jewellery in Mahim on Wednesday evening. The owner, Bharat Jain, had previously reported receiving messages demanding ₹10 crore. The assailants fled toward Bandra. The shop owner had reportedly ignored multiple threats sent throughout the month of October.

stories.title: Gold loan limits adjusted in Tamil Nadu
stories.summary: Cooperative banks in Tamil Nadu have reportedly reduced the gold loan ceiling from ₹10,000 to ₹9,000 per gram. Fluctuations in gold prices directly impact loan eligibility for farmers and small traders. Borrowers are currently seeking clarity on how these institutions calculate loan amounts amid the lower per-gram limit.

stories.title: Two-tone boots emerge as winter trend
stories.summary: Winter 2026 fashion is moving away from solid black or brown boots in favor of two-tone designs. Chanel’s autumn/winter 2026 collection highlighted the style, which features contrasting colors and a considered finish. The trend is positioned as an elevated alternative to the standard footwear that dominates winter wardrobes.

stories.title: Fleece layers gain winter fashion status
stories.summary: Fleece is being promoted as an essential winter layer for both errands and home comfort. While cashmere and wool coats remain staples, editors suggest that fleece has become a cooler, more practical addition to seasonal wardrobes. The material is currently being styled for a variety of winter activities.

stories.title: Red jeans become a seasonal trend
stories.summary: Colored denim is gaining popularity, with red emerging as the specific hue favored by fashion enthusiasts. Riley Keough recently styled red jeans with a tonal brown suede trench coat and accessories. The color is being presented as a fresh alternative to traditional blue and black denim rotations.

stories.title: Bentley reveals illuminated diamond grille
stories.summary: Bentley has previewed its fourth model line, the Torcal, featuring a front grille with 76 individually machined, diamond-shaped elements. The design incorporates over 260,000 laser-drilled micro-holes and 202 LEDs. The vehicle also includes Micro LED projectors to provide what the company calls a new nighttime signature for the brand.

stories.title: Fur trim defines winter coat season
stories.summary: Fur-trimmed coats have become the season's defining garment, appearing on collars, cuffs, and hemlines. Demand for high-end versions, such as the Conner Ives embroidered silk robe coat, has led to preorders extending into February. The trend has expanded beyond outerwear to include sweaters, cardigans, and various footwear.

stories.title: Bootcut jeans lead winter denim edit
stories.summary: Designers and retailers have shifted focus to the bootcut silhouette for winter 2026. The current version features a high rise and a slight kick below the knee, intended to balance high-volume coats. Extreme skinny jeans remain the weakest fit in current runway and search data for the season.

stories.title: Handbag charms rise in luxury fashion
stories.summary: Luxury handbags are increasingly adorned with bejewelled initials, silk scarves, and plush toys. The trend of personalizing bags is described as a canvas for expression, with owners using charms to distinguish their accessories. While some credit the Labubu trend, the practice dates back to Jane Birkin in the 1980s.

stories.title: Salvador Dalí influence returns to fashion
stories.summary: The surrealist designs of Salvador Dalí are being revisited in a new exhibition at Palazzo Reale in Milan. The showcase features pieces from Schiaparelli’s spring/summer 2024 collection, which reimagines the lobster motif Dalí originally designed for a 1937 gown. The exhibition explores the long-standing intersection of surrealism and style.

stories.title: Julianne Hough wears micro minidress for finale
stories.summary: Julianne Hough concluded the season finale of Dancing with the Stars wearing a gold fringe micro minidress by Celia Kritharioti. The look was styled with delicate jewelry from Effy. The outfit was shared by stylist Brad Goreski, who highlighted the use of understated sparkle for the ballroom event.

stories.title: Arvind to deploy 3D weaving technology in Ahmedabad
stories.summary: Arvind Limited has partnered with San Francisco based unspun to introduce industrial scale 3D garment weaving to India. The company will install two machines at its Ahmedabad facility by December 2026, with plans for 30 more across India and North America. The machines weave yarn directly into garments.

stories.title: Government targets 350 billion dollar textile market by 2030
stories.summary: Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh stated the Centre aims to expand India’s textile market to 350 billion dollars by 2030-31. The government is currently assessing progress across handlooms, handicrafts, the jute industry and state textile departments to reach the target. Growth is expected to be accelerated by policy.

stories.title: Cotton textile industry remains a pillar of Indian manufacturing
stories.summary: India is the world’s second largest producer of textiles and garments, with the cotton sector contributing 2.3 percent to the national GDP. The industry covers the entire value chain from cultivation to garment manufacturing, supporting millions of farmers and workers while ranking sixth in global textile exports.

stories.title: Kutch Arts expands wholesale supply of Ajrakh garments
stories.summary: Kutch-based manufacturer Kutch Arts is scaling its pan-India B2B network to supply authentic Ajrakh garments to boutiques and retailers. The company combines traditional block printing techniques with contemporary designs, operating its manufacturing base from Madhapar in Gujarat to meet the growing demand for ethnic wear across the country.

stories.title: Eastman Exports to build smart garment facility in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Tirupur-based Eastman Exports will invest 266.2 crore rupees to establish a smart garment facility in Andhra Pradesh. The project is expected to generate 4,500 jobs across three units, with the first unit scheduled to begin commercial production in April 2027. It is the company's first expansion since 1983.

stories.title: Tüfekçi Makine to showcase climate control at India ITME 2026
stories.summary: Türkiye-based Tüfekçi Makine will present its textile climate control and waste collection systems at India ITME 2026. The company claims its technology improves machinery performance and reduces yarn breakages through precise humidity management. The firm has been developing application-oriented solutions for the textile sector since the 1990s.

stories.title: Sanathan Textiles to increase capacity in Punjab
stories.summary: Sanathan Textiles will expand its Punjab facility to 900 metric tonnes per day, a 28.6 percent increase. The company expects the expansion to unlock 1,000 crore rupees in incremental annual revenue. Commercial commissioning of the new production stream is scheduled to begin in December 2026.

stories.title: Chennai couple donates 208 crore in gold and diamonds
stories.summary: A Chennai-based couple donated 121 kilograms of gold ornaments and diamonds worth 208 crore rupees to the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams. The offering, which included 238.2 carats of diamonds, is described as the largest individual donation ever made to Lord Venkateswara. The state chief minister attended the event.

stories.title: Circular Fashion Technology: NEURYN Robotics Brings AI Robots to E-Commerce Returns… - Trend Hunter
Retailers prepare for Black Friday and Cyber Monday
stories.summary: The annual shopping events on November 27 and 30 are expected to generate significant promotional activity. Critics point to environmental concerns including waste and carbon emissions from deliveries, alongside labour exploitation issues. Consumers are being encouraged to approach the period with more mindful shopping habits this year.

stories.title: Stonepillow to host sustainable fashion show
stories.summary: Charity Stonepillow will hold a fashion show on December 8 in Walberton to raise funds for people experiencing homelessness. The event features outfits made from pre-loved clothing donated to the charity. Guests will be able to purchase items showcased on the catwalk and browse additional second-hand clothing rails.

stories.title: Spinnova and Positive Materials form partnership
stories.summary: Spinnova and Portuguese firm Positive Materials have signed a preferred partnership agreement to commercialise sustainable textile fibres. The companies have previously collaborated on material development and fabric creation. The new deal aims to transition Spinnova’s signature fibre from trials toward commercially viable applications in the global textile market.

Using our codes and links may earn us a commission,supporting the work we do. Learn more. Good On You believes everyone should have access to more sustainable and affordable options

stories.title: On launches data initiative for footwear manufacturing
stories.summary: Swiss brand On has partnered with Fashion for Good and Carbonfact to launch Project Footprints Unpacked. The initiative aims to collect primary manufacturing impact data to improve emissions reporting in the footwear industry. The companies intend to address the current lack of granularity in environmental impact data.

stories.title: PETA to protest wool sales at H&M
stories.summary: PETA plans to stage a demonstration outside H&M in New York on Black Friday, featuring a mock sheep shearing. The protest follows an investigation into a South African wool farm linked to the retailer. The organisation is campaigning against the company's continued sale of wool products.

stories.title: Companies appoint nature proxies to boards
stories.summary: The Nature on the Board movement is encouraging companies to appoint a proxy for nature to their boards of directors. Faith In Nature, which previously used the slogan nature is the boss, is among the firms seeking to give legal footing to the rights of nature in corporate governance.

stories.title: Tariff changes create uncertainty for Indian textile exporters
stories.summary: Indian textile exporters suggest a 17 percent US tariff rate offers limited competitive advantage compared to rivals in Bangladesh and Malaysia. Frequent regulatory changes are reportedly causing uncertainty for exporters and their overseas buyers. The US remains the largest export market for India's toy and textile sectors.

stories.title: Tariff threat likely to hasten India-US trade deal, says Jefferies report
stories.summary: The US has proposed 25 percent tariffs on Indian goods following a manufacturing overcapacity probe. A Jefferies report suggests this could push both nations to sign a reciprocal trade agreement, which would lower India’s tariff rate to 17 percent. Public hearings are scheduled to begin on January 25.

stories.title: Proposed 25% US tariffs could hit Indian gem and jewellery exports
stories.summary: The Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council warned that proposed US tariffs could reverse recent export growth. India’s gem and jewellery exports to the US rose 14.87 percent to $3,607 million between April and October 2026. The new duties threaten to increase costs and reduce competitiveness for Indian exporters.

stories.title: Trump tariff threat puts Indian gems, jewellery exports on the edge
stories.summary: The Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council reports that the sector faces prolonged uncertainty over US trade measures. While exports grew 14.87 percent to $3,607 million year-on-year through October, the council notes that the US market supports roughly 200,000 jobs that could be affected by higher landed costs.

stories.title: Tariff hikes, market access uncertainty may hurt Indian gem, jewellery exports
stories.summary: The US Trade Representative is investigating 16 jurisdictions, including India, regarding structural excess capacity in manufacturing. The Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council stated that proposed tariff hikes and market access uncertainty could hurt the competitiveness of Indian exports and squeeze margins for businesses across the sector.

stories.title: Indian luxury labels urged to focus on domestic scale
stories.summary: Experts at the Fortune India Business of Luxury Summit 2026 suggested that Indian labels should prioritize building strong businesses at home to become lasting global brands. While international markets provide visibility, speakers noted that India offers the necessary scale to support long-term growth for luxury fashion houses.

stories.title: Textile exports to US down 25% in 9 months
stories.summary: Indian textile exports to the US reached $4.14 billion between January and September 2025. The Indian Texpreneurs Federation attributed recent declines to tariff uncertainty, noting that overall US apparel imports fell 6.1 percent during the same period in 2026. Buyers are now showing renewed interest in Indian sourcing.

stories.title: Indian luxury sector seeks to move beyond manufacturing
stories.summary: Speakers at the Fortune India Business of Luxury Summit said the country must transition from a manufacturing destination to an originator of design. The panel argued that highlighting heritage and creative talent is essential for India to establish itself as a global powerhouse in the luxury fashion industry.

stories.title: Zara begins annual Black Friday sale
stories.summary: Zara has launched its annual Black Friday event, offering up to 40 percent off select clothing, footwear, and handbags. The Spanish retailer is known for being selective with markdowns, making the sale one of the most anticipated shopping opportunities of the year for the brand's customers.

stories.title: D2C brands expect double-digit sales growth for Black Friday
stories.summary: Direct-to-consumer brands are projecting sales growth of 10 to 25 percent for the November 27 Black Friday event. Companies are betting on increased consumer interest in premium products across beauty, wellness, and fashion categories as the global shopping event gains further traction in the Indian market.

stories.title: Black Friday sales momentum grows in India
stories.summary: Retailers including H&M, Zara, Sephora, and Nykaa are offering discounts of up to 70 percent as Black Friday gains popularity in India. Originally a US shopping event, the promotion has evolved into an additional window for brands to clear inventory following the end of the Diwali festive season.

stories.title: Libas founder joins fashion reality show
stories.summary: Sidhant Keshwani, founder and CEO of Libas, has joined the second season of the fashion entrepreneurship reality show Pitch To Get Rich. The program features a panel including Manish Malhotra and Karan Johar, focusing on the scaling and business development of emerging Indian fashion and lifestyle brands.

stories.title: AI in the Fashion Industry: 8 Ways Brands and Retailers Use It
stories.summary: AI in the fashion industry is now part of everyday work, not a side experiment. Brands and retailers use it to sketch and test designs, forecast demand, plan assortments, produce product imagery, let shoppers try items on, answer customer questions and run resale programs. stories.title: Hyderabad retailers announce Black Friday promotions
stories.summary: Shoppers in Hyderabad can expect various Black Friday promotions starting November 27. Retailers across fashion, footwear, and electronics have announced campaigns, with some brands extending discounts through the weekend. The event continues to be adopted by Indian retailers to attract customers both online and in physical stores.

stories.title: Hyderabad fashion retailers offer Black Friday discounts
stories.summary: Fashion brands in Hyderabad are offering discounts for the Black Friday period. Zara is advertising up to 40 percent off, while H&M, Zudio, and Max Fashion are offering between 30 and 40 percent. The promotions cover clothing, beauty, and lifestyle products across various malls and retail outlets.

stories.title: Black Friday evolves into Indian retail staple
stories.summary: Black Friday has shifted from a niche western concept to a local retail event in India. E-commerce giants and international brands have adapted the timing to align with the wedding season and winter wear demand, creating a dedicated shopping window for consumers to discover discounted products.

stories.title: IMC Models Agency marks 11 years of operations
stories.summary: IMC Models Agency is celebrating 11 years of fashion, international recognition and lasting friendships. The agency reports runway event results, international collaborations and model development as part of its anniversary. The team describes itself as the human heart of the agency's journey through The House of Fashion.

stories.title: Fashion retail leadership changes announced
stories.summary: K-Way has appointed former The North Face executive Edouard Gros as chief product officer. Lululemon has named Paula Conhain as its new chief communications officer, effective 30 November. Meanwhile, Superdry chief operating officer Shaun Packe is stepping down after 15 years to join a luxury womenswear brand.

stories.title: Armaf partners with Neymar Jr. for fragrance line
stories.summary: Dubai-based fragrance brand Armaf has partnered with soccer player Neymar Jr. to release a new fragrance next year. The company described the deal as a meeting of sport, style and fragrance. Armaf did not disclose financial terms of the agreement. The brand intends to lead the way.

stories.title: Prudential Fashion Academy awards ₦30 million in scholarships
stories.summary: Prudential Fashion Academy graduated more than 600 students at its 2026 Seed to Bloom ceremony. The event included a competition with a ₦6 million grand prize and the announcement of ₦30 million in total scholarships for aspiring designers. The academy was founded by designer Prudent Gabriel-Okopi.

stories.title: Nike revives Gyakusou running collection
stories.summary: Nike and Jun Takahashi are reviving the Gyakusou collection after a five-year hiatus. The range launches in December and combines cold-weather apparel with new footwear. The brand claims the line has never separated product performance from aesthetics. Function and design have shaped one another from the beginning.

stories.title: Kukoon Rugs sponsors sustainable fashion event
stories.summary: Newry company Kukoon Rugs served as the headline sponsor for the Fashioning the Future event in Bangor. The evening raised more than £20,000 for the charity Concern Worldwide. The event encouraged attendees to think differently about sustainable fashion and to challenge the industry's existing throwaway culture.

stories.title: ASU FIDM to host Vogue summer program
stories.summary: Vogue College of Fashion will expand its pre-college summer school to Los Angeles in 2027 through a partnership with ASU FIDM. The two-week program for students aged 15 to 18 focuses on fashion media, journalism and styling. The curriculum utilizes the city's entertainment infrastructure as a primary case.
